title: Sum of Number and Its Reverse
summary: Determine if a non-negative integer can be represented as the sum of another non-negative integer and its reverse, returning true or false accordingly.
statement: Determine if a non-negative integer can be represented as the sum of another non-negative integer and its reverse, returning true or false accordingly.
constraints: Reverse x’s decimal digits, dropping leading zeroes in the reversed numeric value.
Return whether x + reverse(x) equals num.
hints: Enumerate x from zero through num because larger x cannot be part of a non-negative sum equaling num.
Reverse its decimal representation and convert back to an integer.
Return true on the first equality, otherwise false after the search.
The finite loop examines every possible non-negative candidate and tests the defining equation directly.
editorial: The finite loop examines every possible non-negative candidate and tests the defining equation directly.

tests.explanation: Choose x=172; reverse(172)=271 and their sum is 443.
No non-negative integer plus its decimal reversal equals 63.
